dogecoin.text:
【Dogwifhat Leaps】

Dogwifhat surges 4% post-Robinhood Europe listing, leading dog-themed coins with a 224.5% weekly gain. Amid a crypto rally, Solana, its base, also climbs. Meme coins show volatility, yet some like Dogecoin endure through shifting trends.

【Crypto's Big Week】

Bitcoin surged to $64,000, yet meme coins like Dogecoin took the spotlight. DOGE soared 50%, while Pepe rocketed 200%. Ethereum and Solana also saw gains of 18% and 30% respectively. Amidst new highs in the crypto world, meme coins are stealing the show.
